title: Research-Note Search and Deduplication
initial_prompt: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

stages.message: Read TASK.md and complete the requested workflow using only the Python standard library.

`inputs/notes-new/` contains 600 new and edited notes. Add an `update` command that refreshes changed paths, removes deleted paths listed in `inputs/deleted.txt`, and preserves deterministic search results. The command is `python3.12 -E -S -m solution.notes_index update workspace/notes.db inputs/notes-new inputs/deleted.txt output/duplicates.csv`. Each recursive `.md` path relative to `notes-new` is the database path to insert or replace. Each nonempty line of `deleted.txt` is a database path to remove; the fixture does not list a path in both places. Keep the stored stop words and rewrite the duplicate report from the complete post-update database.
